$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Agent Guidance settings: cmux's built-in guidance for the agents it runs and the person's own skills (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/agent_guidance.rs, plans/cmux-next/agent-guidance-DESIGN.md). The daemon reads these keys from the settings file when a chat is created; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: agentGuidance
lists.note: Settings > Agents > Guidance and Skills (Leo, 2026-11-05: "cmux-next should add a few and we can think about extending them as well and letting other users define stuff too!"). Each switch applies to chats created after the change.

rows.name: guidanceClaude
rows.note: On: a new Claude Code chat gets the cmux:cmux-chat skill's first-turn pointer (agent_guidance.rs CLAUDE_GUIDANCE). The skill itself stays listed either way.

help.text: New Claude Code chats are told how cmux shows their work: the plan checklist, side sessions, session links and the closing recap.

rows.name: guidanceCodex
rows.note: On: a new Codex chat gets cmux's chat guidance as first-turn context (agent_guidance.rs AGENT_GUIDANCE), the channel Codex uses for AGENTS.md.

help.text: New Codex chats are told how cmux shows their work: the plan checklist, side sessions, session links and the closing recap.

rows.name: guidanceOtherAgents
rows.note: On: every other harness (Gemini, OpenCode, pi, your own) gets the same first-turn guidance as Codex.

help.text: Other agents (Gemini, OpenCode and the ones you added) get the same guidance about how cmux shows their work.

rows.name: guidanceUserSkills
rows.note: On: the skills in ~/.config/cmux/skills/<name>/SKILL.md reach every new chat: Claude Code as the cmux-user plugin, other agents as an index of names, descriptions and paths in the first-turn context.

help.text: Skills you put in ~/.config/cmux/skills, one folder each with a SKILL.md, reach every new agent chat.
